**q25.** Engine: Google CEL (`github.com/google/cel-go`, `go.mod:13`) wrapped by the in-repo package `internal/filter` (`engine.go:13` `Engine`, `DefaultEngine` at `engine.go:111`, schema in `schema.go`, SQL emission in `render.go`). Mechanism: the handler appends the request's CEL filter string to `FindMemo.Filters` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:215,223`); each dialect driver's `ListMemos` calls `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.DialectSQLite|DialectMySQL|DialectPostgres, &where, &args)` (`store/db/sqlite/memo.go:57-63` and the postgres/mysql equivalents), which compiles CEL into a dialect-agnostic condition tree and renders it to dialect-specific SQL + bound args (dialect-specific templates at `internal/filter/schema.go:105-135`, placeholder offsetting for `$n` vs `?` in `render.go`).

**q26.** `memo_relation` (both directions), `attachment`, `memo` (comment memos also delete their own `memo_relation`/`attachment` rows) — `store/memo.go:140-159`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:566-579`; plus `memo_share`, removed by the DB-level `FOREIGN KEY (memo_id) REFERENCES memo(id) ON DELETE CASCADE` (`store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql:102-111`). `reaction` rows are read for the webhook payload but **not** deleted.

**q27.** Mechanism: the built React bundle is embedded into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's static middleware plus an SPA `index.html` fallback. Wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:21-59` (`FrontendService.Serve`), invoked from `server/server.go:70`.

**q28.**
```
s3presign.Runner — RunOnce at startup, then a 12-hour time.Ticker (server/server.go:157-166; server/runner/s3presign/runner.go:27-40)
```
That is the only background runner started. Unused infrastructure:
- `internal/scheduler` (a full cron-expression job scheduler, `internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `parser.go`, `job.go`) is referenced only by its own tests (`example_test.go`, `integration_test.go`) — nothing in `server/` or `cmd/` uses it.
- `server/runner/memopayload.Runner`/`NewRunner` (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:16-26`) is never instantiated; only the package's `RebuildMemoPayload` helper is called inline from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108,447`.

**q29.**
```
interceptor path — web/src/connect.ts:152 (authInterceptor; attached to the transport at :185), with token storage in web/src/auth-state.ts
token kinds — short-lived access token (JWT) sent as "Authorization: Bearer …", persisted in localStorage and cross-tab-synced via BroadcastChannel; a refresh token held in an HttpOnly cookie (fetch uses credentials:"include", web/src/connect.ts:59-64) used by AuthService.RefreshToken; personal access tokens (PATs) are also accepted as Bearer by the backend
backend package — server/auth (server/auth/authenticator.go: AuthenticateByAccessTokenV2 :41, AuthenticateByRefreshToken :61, AuthenticateByPAT :102), driven by the shared Authorizer used by both the Connect NewAuthInterceptor and the gateway middleware (server/router/api/v1/v1.go:67-90,131-136; server/router/api/v1/connect_interceptors.go:213-231)
```

```

memo updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (called at memo_update_helpers.go:67)

comment created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (called at memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` → `webhook.Post` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` / `:120`.
